items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Fred Guy, Sonny Grier, Braut on bass, Bubba and -- [INTERVIEWEE] Tricky Sam was on trombone. Yeah.

ctx.x: And Sonny, the guitar player. And Braut on bass, of course, Duke on the piano. And we just had -- that was all, at that time.
Fred Guy, Sonny Grier, Braut on bass, Bubba and --
Tricky Sam was on trombone. Yeah.
